LanguageData.GM21_TooltipAchieved: Grandmaster\nThis pawn has transcended normal mastery of this skill. Only a Grandmaster can produce Legendary-quality work.
LanguageData.GM21_Setting_RequirementDesc: Extra experience a pawn must earn after reaching level 20 before becoming a Grandmaster.\nCurrent: {0} XP. Allowed range: {1} - {2}.
LanguageData.GM21_Setting_DeterministicQualityDesc: Pawn-created quality is decided by skill band instead of a random roll:\n0-3 Awful, 4-7 Poor, 8-10 Normal, 11-13 Good, 14-16 Excellent, 17-20 Masterwork, 21 Legendary.\nTurning this off restores vanilla's random roll, but Legendary still requires level 21.
LanguageData.GM21_Setting_PreventDecayDesc: A level 21 skill never falls back to 20. Skills below 21 decay exactly as in vanilla.
LanguageData.GM21_Setting_ShowProgressDesc: Adds Grandmaster progress to the skill tooltip and a star beside a Grandmaster skill.
LanguageData.GM21_Setting_ClampGeneratedDesc: Newly generated pawns can never start above level 20. This is what makes level 21 meaningful and should normally stay on.
LanguageData.GM21_Setting_ClampGeneratedWarning: Warning: with this off, pawn generation and other mods may create level 21 pawns directly. Level 21 will no longer prove anything was earned.
